Pet friendly clinic
Our Vet clinic is proud to provide the topmost level of
veterinary care
for your pets covering all aspects of animal health in a soothing and compassionate environment. Also, our dedicated team are available to make your visit go smoothly.
They are all pet owners and animal lovers, so they understand how stressful and upsetting it can be when your pet is unwell
.
Whether it’s a lifesaving
surgery
,
routine check-ups
or
vaccinations
, our team of well trained and
experienced veterinarians
and support staff can provide the best medical and surgical care for animals.
For further information or requests, do not hesitate to
contact us
.
Emergency care
As misfortune and accidents might happen unexpectedly, our emergency service will help. The wellbeing of your pet is our priority.
Pet grooming
A vet clinic is not only a place where we take care of your pet’s health but it also must be a place to pamper it. We offer grooming packages: shaving, showering, nail trimming and ear cleaning.
Vaccination
We advise you to vaccinate your pet at an early age. Whether it is canine parvovirus or feline panleukopenia, the vaccine will provide your pet with necessary immunity to decrease the risk of infection and severe symptoms.
Euthanasia
Euthanasia provides a compassionate and humane option to end the suffering of cats and dogs when they are facing incurable pain or severe medical conditions.
Microshipping
Microshipping: Safely transporting our beloved cats and dogs to their new homes: Ensuring a stress-free journey for our furry companions during long-distance travel.
Referral services
If you’re looking for an orthopedic referral service for cats and dogs, once you agree that your pet requires referral, we can then refer your pet to a specialist for care.
We care about your pet well being
We are well aware that it can be stressful to have to bring your cat to the clinic, and that
cats are independent, territorial animals that need to be in control of their surroundings and are sensitive to different smells
. So, we are proud to say that we are known as a cat friendly clinic; this means that we have met all the requirement needed to ensure that your cat is getting all the care and needs it requires.
We are trained to handle your feline patient in a manner that minimizes stress, fear, and anxiety.
The clients’ recommendations approve this reputation.
In the waiting room, we have provided a separate cat waiting area so that the cats feel safer far from the reach of dogs.
In our
veterinary clinic
, we prioritize the safety and well-being of all animals, especially dogs. We understand that dogs can sometimes become agitated or territorial when they are in close proximity to one another. That’s why we have taken careful measures to ensure that there is enough space to separate dogs and prevent any potential conflicts. By providing ample room and individual enclosures, we minimize the chances of dogs getting too close and engaging in fights. Our spacious environment allows each dog to feel comfortable and secure during their visit, creating a stress-free atmosphere for both pets and their owners. Our dedicated team of professionals is always vigilant and ready to step in if any signs of aggression arise, ensuring the utmost safety for all our canine patients.
In the examination room, all staff should treat cats gently and skillfully. Staff should take time to allow cats to calm down. If you are unsure about administering medications or any other questions, for further explanation please ask the vet to help you.
We have a separate quiet cat ward (for boarding and hospitalization) with clean, secure, and good-sized cages where cats can recover from illness and surgery in peace and where they are been watched on our CCTV system to supervise them all the time. Visiting your cat at the clinic is allowed for not more than 10-15 minutes per day.
We are available to answer any questions or concerns you may have and to provide information and advice on caring for your cat.
